classes.name: Lantern-Wall Warden
classes.subtitle: Shield of the Ash-Frontier
classes.description: Hardened frontier vanguard trained to hold the viaduct against salt-horrors with steel, shield, and grim resolve.

classFeatures.name: Bastion Brace
classFeatures.desc: +2 Armor Class while carrying a shield in your off-hand.

classFeatures.name: Lantern Flare
classFeatures.desc: Blaze ash-light into up to 2 foes: 1d6+2 damage and Weakened for 2 rounds (once per combat, 1 Stamina).

classFeatures.name: Warden's Second Breath
classFeatures.desc: Steel yourself against frontier dread: restore 2d6+2 Health (once per combat, 2 Stamina).

classes.name: Mnemonic Arcanist
classes.subtitle: Weaver of Bottled Memory
classes.description: Scholar of distilled memory and threshold seals who excels at expanding spell repertoires via Arcane Knowledge Points and Spell Shaping.

classFeatures.name: Mnemonic Echo
classFeatures.desc: +2 bonus on Mythology & Lore and Investigation checks.

classFeatures.name: Prism Pulse
classFeatures.desc: Shatter bottled essence across up to 2 foes for 1d8+2 damage (once per combat, 1 Stamina).

classFeatures.name: Lucid Recall
classFeatures.desc: Reclaim clarity amidst battle: restore 1d8+3 Health and steady morale (once per combat, 2 Stamina).

classes.name: Freebooter Runner
classes.subtitle: Shadow of the Drowned Piers
classes.description: Nimble contraband runner and frontier sharpshooter skilled in locks, misty alleys, and lethal cover-bypassing shots.

classFeatures.name: Fog-Runner's Step
classFeatures.desc: +1 Ranged Attack and +2 Stealth checks in misty borders.

classFeatures.name: Brine-Flash Shot
classFeatures.desc: Blind and strike any target from cover: 1d8+2 damage and Confused for 2 rounds (once per combat, 1 Stamina).

classFeatures.name: Pier-Runner's Sever
classFeatures.desc: Vicious crippling strike dealing 2d6+2 damage and Bleeding for 2 rounds (once per combat, 2 Stamina).

classes.name: Bellwright Cantor
classes.subtitle: Voice of the Last Bell
classes.description: Devoted caster of consecrated bronze who blends sturdy mace-craft with restorative chants and spirit-calming wards.

classFeatures.name: Resonant Calm
classFeatures.desc: +2 Medicine checks and steadier healing rites.

classFeatures.name: Chime of Quiet
classFeatures.desc: Ring a restorative cadence: heal 2d6+2 Health (once per combat, 1 Stamina).

classFeatures.name: Toll of Breaking
classFeatures.desc: Shattering bell-wave dealing 1d10+3 damage and Frightening the target for 2 rounds (once per combat, 2 Stamina).

classes.name: Crucible Alchemist
classes.subtitle: Master of Ash & Artifice
classes.description: Ingenious distiller and forge-tinkerer turning Aether-Ash, kiln-glass, and cinder-pitch into lethal flasks and superior crafted gear.

classFeatures.name: Crucible Hand
classFeatures.desc: +2 Investigation and Medicine checks when appraising reagents and crafting.

classFeatures.name: Cinder-Pitch Flask
classFeatures.desc: Hurl volatile slag-pitch across up to 2 foes: 1d8+2 damage and Bleeding for 2 rounds (once per combat, 1 Stamina).

classFeatures.name: Emergency Quench-Draught
classFeatures.desc: Drink an instant alchemical tonic: restore 2d6+3 Health (once per combat, 1 Stamina).

classes.name: Chancery Inquisitor
classes.subtitle: Blade of the Ledger-Law
classes.description: Sharp-tongued investigator and heavy enforcer versed in Chancery law, interrogation, and crushing shock-strikes.

classFeatures.name: Auditor's Scrutiny
classFeatures.desc: +2 Persuasion and +1 Investigation checks when uncovering secrets.

classFeatures.name: Final Verdict
classFeatures.desc: Punishing strike dealing 1d10+3 damage and Weakening your target for 2 rounds (once per combat, 1 Stamina).

classFeatures.name: Writ of Forfeiture
classFeatures.desc: Commanding condemnation dealing 2d6+2 damage and Frightening the target for 2 rounds (once per combat, 2 Stamina).
